result.Description:
Security researchers at Check Point Research discovered a malicious package called WINRPCexploit. PyPI has since removed WINRPCexploit.
References
https://pypi.org/project/WINRPCexploit/
https://research.checkpoint.com/2022/cloudguard-spectral-detects-several-malicious-packages-on-pypi-the-official-software-repository-for-python-developers/
